BEFORE

Treasury business cases sit in spreadsheets with hidden assumptions. Executives see one number, months after the workshop.

AFTER

Leaders adjust their own assumptions live and see the combined effect on working capital, bank fees and straight-through processing, along with payback.

The business problem

Treasury transformation competes for investment against every other priority. Executives need a transparent view of where value comes from before committing budget.

Value to evaluate

Makes the value drivers and their sensitivities visible so leaders can discuss assumptions instead of a single headline figure.

Controls & accountability

Every output is derived from inputs shown on screen. Formulas are documented beside the results. Nothing is sent or stored.

Project evidence & maturity

A working prototype with documented formulas and example assumptions. Results are illustrative estimates, not benchmarks or measured client outcomes.
